title: Two-term scalar quotient resolutions after flat sheaf extension
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $A$ a commutative integral domain, $A_{\mathcal C}$ its constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $R$ a commutative sheaf of $A_{\mathcal C}$-algebras which is flat as an $A_{\mathcal C}$-module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For each $0\ne a\in A$, multiplication by $a$ on $R$ is injective. The complex $[R\xrightarrow{a}R]$ in cohomological degrees $-1,0$, augmented to $R/aR$ in degree zero, is a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Also $R[0]$ is K-flat. Hence derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] with $R/aR$ can be computed using that displayed two-term complex.

source.place: Tag 06YU (definition-derived-tor) and Tag 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat); explicit flat scalar extension of the nonzero-scalar quotient resolution

proof.text: A section of the constant ring sheaf is locally represented by an element of A, using the local surjectivity of its sheafification unit [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. If its product with a nonzero scalar a vanishes, local injectivity of that unit further refines the cover so that the product vanishes in A. Since A is a domain, the local representative vanishes. Separatedness gives that the original section vanishes, without an enough-points hypothesis.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-relations-universes] to the restricted R-module sheaf and the one-entry relation ax=0. Locally write x as a finite sum b_q t_q with a b_q=0. Step 1 makes every b_q zero. Separatedness gives x=0, hence the displayed scalar map is monic.

source.place: Tags 03ER and 08FC, one-entry local flat relation

proof.text: The scalar map followed by its cokernel projection is a short exact sequence. Apply the exact degree-zero single-complex functor. Mathlib CochainComplex.mappingCone.descShortComplex supplies the canonical augmentation; inr_descShortComplex identifies its restriction with the cokernel projection, and quasiIso_descShortComplex proves it is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules].

source.place: Tag 06YU, cone augmentation of a two-term regular resolution

proof.text: Every term of R[0] is zero or the tensor unit. Each term of the displayed cone is a binary biproduct of such terms, so all these terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The explicit site tensor agrees with the monoidal tensor by the comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits]. Both complexes vanish above degree zero. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-independent-bounded-flat-kflat]. Together with Step 3 this gives the required K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex].

The fixed-right-factor representative comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated] identifies total tensor with the displayed flat-term K-flat cone with derived tensor with its localized image, for every unbounded M. The augmentation of Step 3 becomes an isomorphism after localization. Apply derived tensor with QM to its inverse and then the inverse representative comparison. This is the required isomorphism with tensor by the actual quotient.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YQ and 06YU; scalar injectivity by local sheafification representatives and the one-relation flat criterion of Modules on Sites Tags 03ER and 08FC. Proved by U1 and compiler-checked with no warnings.

lean.statement: theorem flat_scalar_cyclic_resolution [IsDomain A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (scalarCyclicRing R))] (hflat : IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := scalarCyclicBase J A) ((restrictScalars ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map α)).obj (unit (scalarCyclicRing R)))) (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Mono (scalarCyclicMultiplication R α a) ∧ ∃ ε : scalarCyclicComplex R α a ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (scalarCyclicQuotient R α a), CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map (scalarCyclicMultiplication R α a)) ≫ ε = (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map (cokernel.π (scalarCyclicMultiplication R α a)) ∧ CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients ε ∧ CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (unit (scalarCyclicRing R))) ∧ ∀ M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} (scalarCyclicRing R)) ℤ, Nonempty ((siteDerivedTensorIndependentCoefficients J R).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M, DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (scalarCyclicQuotient R α a))) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor M (scalarCyclicComplex R α a) (curriedTensor _)))
lean.note: The auxiliary abbreviations reuse the recorded constant sheaf and module category. The scalar map is constructed from the sheafification adjunction, the displayed complex is its degree-zero mapping cone, and the quotient is its sheaf cokernel. The augmentation is specified by the cokernel projection, and the final clause uses the existing independent-coefficient derived tensor.
